key_insight: TimeSeek combines adaptive multi-domain feature extraction with collaborative multi-task pretraining to generalize time series analytics across forecasting, anomaly detection, and classification.
engineering_relevance: A shared model could reduce task-specific model maintenance while adapting to varied temporal patterns and channel relationships.
method: Progressive multi-scale modeling captures domain-dependent temporal dependencies.
Adaptive slot channel modeling captures channel correlations.
Task customization and cross-task training balance task specificity with shared knowledge.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports large-scale time series pretraining and state-of-the-art performance across three tasks in few-shot and zero-shot settings, with favorable inference efficiency, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Dataset coverage, computational costs, and performance on unseen domains require verification beyond the abstract.
paper_title: TimeSeek: Multi-Task and Multi-Domain Pretraining for Generalized Time Series Analytics
